content.text: Discussion section written to `paper/sections/discussion.tex`. Four paragraphs covering: (1) why lightweight gating fails structurally under teacher-forcing + NTP pressure, (2) four evidence-derived directions (inference-time intervention, decoupled pathway, GAR-aware decoding, exposure bias mitigation), (3) convergent evidence with Dongre et al. using hedged language for the re-injection conjecture, (4) honest scope limitations including PCGrad boundaries and single-model caveat. ~410 words, no dashes, no -ing endings, no AI-style phrasing.
